# ShrooMEED

> ShrooMEED Nutraceutical makes Cordyceps militaris supplements for respiratory health, stamina and recovery. Our product, Daily Shield, is a two-capsule daily formula with a fully disclosed label — no proprietary blends. Made in India by FSSAI and GMP-certified manufacturers, ISO certified, third-party lab tested, and HPLC-verified with cordycepin at 1% or higher.

## Product

- [Daily Shield](https://shroomeed.com/product): Two-capsule daily Cordyceps militaris formula with NAC, Tulsi, Vasaka, Mulethi, Curcumin, Ginger, Vitamin C and Pippali. Full ingredient amounts per capsule, pricing, and supply options.
- [The science](https://shroomeed.com/science): Research behind Cordyceps militaris and each supporting ingredient — studied for stamina, respiratory performance and VO2 max.
- [Research library](https://shroomeed.com/researches): Collected studies referenced across the site.

- We describe ingredients as "studied for" or "may support" because that is what the research allows.
- We ship across India only. No international shipping at this time.
